title: TradingPlanOrdersSchema
description: Schema for the order set the Lead Portfolio Manager Agent authors ahead of rendering a weekly trading plan. Every trade decision, every limit price, and every rationale in this file is the agent's. scripts/render_plan.py validates this file against the strategy mandate in AGENTS.md section 5, recomputes the collateral and cash arithmetic, and renders the plain-ASCII plan conforming to trading_plan_schema.json. The renderer selects no trades and writes no rationale.

plan_date.description: Monday of the execution week. All orders are entered in one session on this date.

authored_by.description: Agent role that decided these orders, normally 'Lead Portfolio Manager Agent'.

snapshot_source.description: Path of the brokerage export in private/snapshots/ these orders were built against.

portfolios.description: One entry per account. Accounts stay isolated: an order in one portfolio never draws on another's collateral (AGENTS.md section 4).

account_name.description: Account label. Must match an account parsed from the snapshot.

orders.description: Ordered list of orders to submit in a single Monday session. Rendered in array order.

expirations.description: Expected Friday settlement outcomes for open options, authored by the agent.

action.description: BUY TO OPEN on an OPTION is rejected by the renderer: the mandate prohibits speculative long option purchases (AGENTS.md section 5).

symbol.description: Underlying ticker. Option contracts carry their strike and expiration in the dedicated fields, not appended here.

expiration.description: Option expiration date. Required when security_type is OPTION.

quantity.description: Shares for EQUITY, contracts for OPTION. Always positive; direction comes from action.

order_type.description: Limit only. A market order cannot be priced ahead of a single-session Monday entry.

limit_price.description: Per-share price for EQUITY, per-contract premium for OPTION.

time_in_force.description: Defaults to DAY. GTC for orders intended to rest past the session.

rationale.description: The agent's reason for this order, in its own words. The renderer never composes this.

contingency.description: Deterministic execution-time branching for orders whose price depends on the market at entry (AGENTS.md section 5). No mid-week waiting.

asserted_collateral_usd.description: The agent's own figure for collateral required. The renderer recomputes it and fails on disagreement.

asserted_cash_impact_usd.description: The agent's own figure for cash impact, negative for a debit. Recomputed and cross-checked.

asserted_aroc_pct.description: The agent's own annualized return on collateral for a short option. Recomputed via calculate_pricing and cross-checked.

expectation.description: The agent's stated settlement expectation for this position at 4:00 PM ET Friday.
